fields.doc: Highest LSN in the main journal at the moment the intent log was captured — the backup's consistency cut. CognitiveDials.name: CognitiveDials
CognitiveDials.doc: Runtime-tunable cognitive parameters for a single user's [`crate::memory::MemorySystem`].

fields.name: reconsolidation_enabled
fields.doc: Master switch for the FIX-R1 reconsolidation expiry + re-encode block in `run_maintenance`. When `false`, shadows are neither expired nor re-encoded (pre-feature behavior).

fields.name: reconsolidation_window_secs
fields.doc: Labile-window length in seconds (used when creating/extending shadows on recall).

fields.name: re_encode_graph_strengthen
fields.doc: Layer 1: strengthen Hebbian graph edges between the memory and the entities found in its accumulated `retrieval_context` at window close.

fields.name: graph_boost_scale
fields.doc: Scale applied to the Layer-1 edge boost (× a function of retrieval count).

fields.name: re_encode_entity_enrich
fields.doc: Layer 2: merge genuinely-new `retrieval_context` entities into the memory's `entity_refs` and persist (re-index) via `update_memory`.

fields.name: re_encode_embedding_nudge
fields.doc: Layer 3: blend the memory's embedding toward the `retrieval_context` embedding and persist (re-index). Heaviest layer; bounded by the active-shadow cap.

fields.name: embedding_blend
fields.doc: Blend factor for Layer 3 (`new = normalize((1-blend)·mem + blend·ctx)`).

fields.name: max_active_shadows
fields.doc: Max simultaneous labile shadows before the oldest (expired-first) are evicted on the recall path. Caps memory + per-cycle re-encode work.

fields.name: working_memory_threshold
fields.doc: Consecutive-retrieval count at/above which a shadow is treated as *working memory* and kept labile (NOT drained at window close). Lower ⇒ drains sooner.

fields.name: refiner_mode
fields.doc: Override the post-fusion refiner stage. `None` keeps the engine default.

fields.name: use_reranking
fields.doc: Override whether the cross-encoder rerank runs. `None` keeps the engine default.

fields.name: use_mmr
fields.doc: Override whether Layer 5.4 MMR diversification runs. `None` keeps the engine default ([`crate::constants::MMR_ENABLED_DEFAULT`], off).

fields.name: candidate_count
fields.doc: Override the initial candidate-pool size. `None` keeps the engine default.

fields.name: rerank_count
fields.doc: Override the rerank top-k. `None` keeps the engine default.

fields.name: rerank_pool
fields.doc: Fused candidates kept for the cross-encoder layer (recall Layer 4's truncation). `None` keeps 30, or 50 for a decomposed query; the pool never drops below `rerank_count`. Raising `rerank_count` alone cannot reach gold that the truncation already cut.

fields.name: rerank_model
fields.doc: Which cross-encoder reranks, by registry id (`crate::embeddings::cross_encoder::lookup`). `None` keeps the process-wide choice (`VELD_CROSS_ENCODER`, else mxbai-rerank-xsmall-v1). Set to `ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2` for the recall gate's parity arm against upstream. [`CognitiveDials::sanitized`] drops an id the registry does not know, so what `GET /api/dials` returns is what reranks.

fields.name: rrf_weights
fields.doc: Override the RRF fusion weights `(bm25, vector, graph)`. `None` keeps the engine/learned weights.

fields.name: date_window_leg
fields.doc: Whether recall adds the date window candidate leg: when a query names a calendar day or month-year, memories whose `created_at` falls in that window enter RRF fusion as their own candidate list (recall.rs Layer 4). `None` and `Some(true)` run it; `Some(false)` leaves the window to the temporal boost only.

fields.name: rrf_k_outer
fields.doc: RRF k for the outer graph+hybrid fusion (recall.rs Layer 4). Default 20.

fields.name: rrf_k_decomp
fields.doc: RRF k for the decomposed sub-query merge. Default 20.

fields.name: rrf_k_inner
fields.doc: RRF k for the inner BM25+vector fusion (hybrid_search). Default 45.

fields.name: secondary_rrf_ratio
fields.doc: Weight ratio of the secondary (768d) vector index signal. Default 0.5.

fields.name: bm25_min_score
fields.doc: BM25 minimum-score floor for lexical candidates. Default 0.1.

fields.name: onto_rerank_boost
fields.doc: Ontological rerank boost per entity-label match. Default 0.15.

fields.name: onto_rerank_max
fields.doc: Ontological rerank boost cap. Default 0.40.

fields.name: onto_rerank_penalty
fields.doc: Ontological rerank mismatch penalty (negative). Default -0.08.

fields.name: ce_blend
fields.doc: Cross-encoder share of the Layer 5.3 blend for every query shape at once, except that Abstract (decomposed) never drops below its own share. `None` lets the per-shape dials and `constants::CE_BLEND_*` decide. See `ce_share`.

fields.name: temporal_recall_boost
fields.doc: Temporal-fact source-memory boost. Default 0.20.

fields.name: ce_blend_identifier
fields.doc: Cross-encoder share for one query shape; each overrides its `constants::CE_BLEND_*` default and is itself overridden by `ce_blend`. See `ce_share`.

fields.name: query_coverage_weight
fields.doc: Layer 5.36 query-term coverage weight; `0` disables. Default `constants::QUERY_COVERAGE_WEIGHT`.

fields.name: people_boost_max
fields.doc: Layer 5.37 person-density boost ceiling for people questions; `0` disables. Default `constants::PEOPLE_BOOST_MAX`.

fields.name: use_prf
fields.doc: Pseudo-relevance feedback leg. Default `constants::PRF_ENABLED_DEFAULT`.

fields.name: prf_docs
fields.doc: Top first-pass documents PRF reads terms from. Default `constants::PRF_DOCS`.

fields.name: prf_terms
fields.doc: Expansion terms PRF appends. Default `constants::PRF_TERMS`.

fields.name: prf_weight
fields.doc: PRF leg weight as a fraction of the hybrid weight. Default `constants::PRF_WEIGHT`.

fields.name: mmr_lambda_exploratory
fields.doc: MMR diversity λ for exploratory queries. Default 0.6.

fields.name: mmr_lambda_abstract
fields.doc: MMR diversity λ for abstract queries. Default 0.5.

fields.name: mmr_lambda_relationship
fields.doc: MMR diversity λ for relationship queries. Default 0.7.

fields.name: density_linguistic_w
fields.doc: Linguistic weight in the density-adaptive fusion mix. Default 0.15.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: Last time these dials were set (set by the writer; informational).
